data.privacyNotice: Student data must not contain names, student numbers or national ID numbers. Uploaded data are never written to disk; they are processed in session memory only.
data.formats: CSV files must be UTF-8; the delimiter may be a semicolon, comma or tab.
data.reading: Reading the file in the R engine…
data.idDetected: Columns that may contain identifying information
data.idHeuristic: This detection is heuristic; it cannot guarantee that every identifying column is found.
data.validGroupsHelp: If left empty, only rows with a missing group value are invalid.
data.cleanOrder: Rules are applied in this order. Straight-lining is detected on raw responses, before reverse coding.

rule.invalid_group: Remove rows with an invalid group value
rule.out_of_range: Remove rows with out-of-range or non-integer values
rule.straightline: Remove rows giving the same answer to every item (straight-lining)

items.heatmapAria: Heat map of category proportions by item

fn.runningLong: Running in the R engine; this may take a few minutes depending on the iterations…
fn.decisionNote: This text is a fixed template; no AI is used. The numbers come from the R engine.

chart.title: Scree plot: observed and reference eigenvalues
chart.aria: Scree plot of observed and reference eigenvalues

model.title: Measurement model
model.dropHere: Drag items here or assign them with the selector next to each item.
model.covNote: Add an error covariance only with a theoretical reason (e.g., similar wording, same instruction).
model.syntaxHint: Advanced use: cross-loadings and second-order factors are allowed; structural regressions (~) are not. Validated by the R engine when you leave the field.
model.previewTitle: lavaan syntax generated by the R engine

efa.fromFactorNumber: Parallel analysis on the Number of factors page suggests {{n}}; the initial value was taken from there.
efa.polyMlWarning: ml is not recommended with polychoric correlations; use minres or uls (EFA-1). The R engine will also warn.
efa.viewNote: Naming and ordering only change the display; coefficients and signs do not change. The R script and report use psych's names.
efa.hideBelow: Hide coefficients with absolute value below {{thr}}

cfa.bsLocked: Available only with the ML estimator, items treated as continuous and complete data (BS-1).
cfa.bsHint: May take a while; the engine keeps responding to other requests.
cfa.miTop: Number of modification indices to show
cfa.compareNote: Models are estimated with the same estimator, likelihood and items. Nested pairs are identified with semTools::net; only those are tested.
cfa.noSaved: No saved models yet. Build a model above and press "Add model to comparison" (at least two models).
cfa.pathAria: Path diagram with standardized loadings from factors to items, factor correlations and error covariances
cfa.pathNote: Values on arrows are standardized loadings (std.all); curved arrows are factor correlations and error covariances. Values are formatted in R.

rel.modelSummary: Measurement model (shared with the CFA page)
rel.modelShared: The model is the same as in the CFA builder; a change in one is reflected in the other.
rel.obsVarTrue: The denominator is the observed (saturated-model) total-score variance; model misfit affects ω.
rel.obsVarFalse: The denominator is the model-implied variance; without error covariances it equals McDonald's ω (CR).
rel.htmt2Hint: When off, the HTMT of Henseler et al. (2015) (arithmetic mean).
rel.absoluteHint: If reverse items are not recoded, the result can be undefined when off.
rel.sources: Threshold sources: Fornell & Larcker (1981) for ω and AVE; Henseler et al. (2015) and Roemer et al. (2021) for HTMT.

inv.dSd: Denominator of the latent effect size d
inv.noPartial: No freed parameters (full invariance is tested).
inv.latentLocked: Latent means locked: each factor needs at least two items with invariant loading and intercept.
inv.needsGroup: For invariance, mark a column as the group variable on the Data page and run cleaning again.
inv.groupInfo: Group variable: {{col}}. The model is shared with the CFA page.
inv.wizardIntro: Score tests are computed for the equality constraints of a step (lavTestScore). Inspect the largest constraint and, if theoretically justified, release it with your own confirmation; the chain is rerun with the new settings.
inv.alsoIntercept: Also release the intercept of an item whose loading is released
inv.alsoInterceptHint: Default: the intercept stays constrained (SPEC I-4). The choice appears in the table note.
inv.dataDriven: Data-driven releases must be validated in an independent sample (Byrne et al., 1989).
inv.scoresStale: These score tests belong to the previous release list; recompute them for the new model.

sim.popHelp: Loadings are standardized in (−1, 1); for ordinal data category proportions are given per item or shared. Latent means of the second group go in groups[].latent_means, DIF scenarios in dif[]. The R engine validates all values.
sim.difNote: Threshold/intercept DIF shifts that group's thresholds or intercept by the size; loading DIF changes the standardized loading. The control (invariant) scenario is always the first condition.

opt.auto: automatic (first step that tests the DIF parameter)

sim.crnNote: Within a replication all estimators use the same data (common random numbers), so estimator differences are not confounded with sampling noise.
sim.perCellHint: The random reference of parallel analysis is generated once per condition; much faster than per replication.
sim.powerAria: Power curve: rejection rate by N
sim.biasAria: Relative bias by parameter and condition
sim.powerNote: In the control (invariant) scenario the rejection rate is the Type I error; in DIF scenarios it is power. Each step is tested on its own (regardless of the previous step).
sim.powerStep: Power step for the sample-size recommendation

report.empty: No results have been added yet. Use the “Add this result to the report” button on the analysis pages.
report.previewTitle: Preview (text produced by the R engine)
report.noAi: The Methods and Results text comes from pre-written templates; numbers are values formatted by the R engine. This section does not use AI. Tables follow APA 7; each table has a source and version line.
report.projectHelp: Settings, result records (17 significant digits), R scripts, version information and the SHA-256 digest of the data. On import, analyses are re-run and results compared.
report.projectNeedsClean: Run the cleaning step on the Data page first.
report.projectCount: Records to include: {{count}} (cleaning and the analysis results on screen).
report.projectExample: Example data are not included; they are reloaded by name on import.
report.consent: I explicitly consent to including the data file in the project file (personal data: KVKK).

project.importHelp: Choose an .olceklab.zip file. Package versions are compared; all analyses are re-run with the same data and results compared at 17 significant digits.
project.dataIncluded: The data file is in the project (added with consent).
project.dataExample: Example data; will be reloaded by name.
project.dataNotIncluded: The data file is not in the project. Upload the same file; its SHA-256 digest is checked.
project.uploadSame: Upload the same data file and reproduce
project.allIdentical: All results are identical at 17 significant digits.
project.notAllIdentical: Some results differ; see the details below.
